arabic text: Ummul Masaaib Ya Zainab\nThey dragged you through kufa and shaam and snatched\nyour veil away
english translation text: Mother of Calamities, O Zainab; they\ndragged you through Kufa and Shaam\nand snatched away your veil.

arabic text:
Oh flower of hashim, Alone you are
Remember abbas, protected you were
Your father said, this day would come
When they would take your veil away
english translation text:
O flower of Hashim, you stand alone.
Remember Abbas, through whom you were protected.
Your father had said this day would come,
when they would take your veil away.

arabic text:
You sacrificed your Own and mohammed
You did not shed one tear for them at all
You Struggled selflessly, you fought bravely
Your kept your promise, to hussein
english translation text:
You sacrificed your Aun and Muhammad,
yet did not shed a single tear for them.
You struggled selflessly and fought bravely;
you fulfilled your promise to Hussain.

arabic text:
Your brothers head on a spear
Pain and angwish, so unbearable
Patience forebareance, you are zainab
Daughter of Ali and fatima
english translation text:
Your brother's head was upon a spear;
the pain and anguish were unbearable.
Patience and forbearance—this is Zainab,
the daughter of Ali and Fatima.

arabic text:
You stood your ground in the court
You spoke like your father, yazid trembled
Scared he was, of your pure words
He tried to silence you, he failed in vain
english translation text:
You stood firm within the court
and spoke in the voice of your father; Yazid trembled.
He feared your pure words
and tried in vain to silence you.

arabic text:
Sisters remember your hijab
Zainab fought for you, with blood and pain
Honour her, respect her memory
Don't give in to vanity, wear it with pride
english translation text:
Sisters, remember your hijab.
Zainab fought for it through blood and pain.
Honour her and respect her memory;
do not surrender to vanity—wear it with pride.
